jobs.title: Associate Project Manager, Device Logistics
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Associate Project Manager, Device Logistics based in Brazil.

In this role, you will coordinate the planning, implementation, and delivery of device logistics projects supporting clinical trials in the life sciences industry. You will oversee project activities from initial setup through closeout, ensuring that mobile devices, inventory, and international shipping operations are delivered on time and within scope. Working closely with subject matter experts, clinical teams, sponsors, and other stakeholders, you will help align project expectations and maintain smooth service delivery. You will also monitor budgets, manage deployment plans, identify potential risks, and develop contingency measures to address challenges. This opportunity is ideal for a detail-oriented project management professional who enjoys cross-functional collaboration and wants to contribute to clinical research operations in a remote working environment aligned with the US East Coast time zone.

Accountabilities

Manage the implementation, delivery, and closeout of device logistics projects supporting electronic clinical outcome assessment (eCOA) studies.
Coordinate with subject matter experts to ensure inventory management, mobile device management, and global shipping activities are completed on schedule.
Oversee project budgets, track allocated hours, and support the change order process when project requirements evolve.
Collaborate with cross-functional clinical teams to define project scope, clarify responsibilities, and establish delivery expectations with key stakeholders.
Develop and maintain project-specific deployment plans, monitoring service delivery throughout the project lifecycle.
Communicate professionally and effectively with internal teams, sponsors, and other project stakeholders.
Identify project risks, establish appropriate contingency plans, and ensure compliance with applicable quality processes.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.
2–3 years of project management experience, ideally involving clinical project delivery.
Experience in the life sciences or pharmaceutical industry.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to organize and monitor multiple project activities.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
Ability to build and maintain effective working relationships with colleagues, managers, clients, and cross-functional stakeholders.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
Ability to work remotely while coordinating effectively with teams operating in the US East Coast time zone.

Benefits

Full-time remote work opportunity, with working hours aligned to the US East Coast time zone.
Opportunity to contribute to clinical research and projects that support the development and delivery of innovative medical treatments.
Collaborative, cross-functional working environment within the life sciences industry.

to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

jobs.title: Project Manager - Temporary until December 2027
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced Project Manager looking for a role where you can lead interesting projects that make a real difference?

Would you enjoy working on projects that explore low-carbon mine water heat, environmental improvements and new services that could help shape the future of our work?

If so, we'd love to hear from you.

You'll already have experience delivering projects from planning through to completion and be comfortable managing multiple priorities, stakeholders and deadlines. You'll know how to keep projects moving forward, manage risks and overcome challenges when they arise. The role requires someone who can work independently, take ownership and confidently lead projects from start to finish.

We're looking for someone who enjoys finding practical solutions, building positive relationships and working with a wide range of people. You'll be able to communicate clearly, analyse information, monitor progress and provide updates that help others make informed decisions.

You don't need experience in our sector, but you will have experience managing projects from planning through to delivery and a good understanding of project management principles and best practice. Experience of introducing improvements, new processes, products or services would be particularly valuable.

You'll also be able to travel when required to our Mansfield office and project sites across the UK, including North East England and South East Scotland.

,

This is a temporary opportunity covering a colleague's secondment, giving you the chance to join an established team and make an immediate impact on a varied portfolio of projects.

As a Project Manager in our Innovation, By-Products and Service Delivery team, you'll help turn new ideas into practical projects that deliver real environmental and business benefits. You'll work on a range of projects, including low-carbon mine water heat, by-products and other innovative opportunities.

You'll be responsible for planning and managing projects from start to finish, working with colleagues, partners and suppliers to make sure projects are delivered safely, effectively and to agreed timescales. You'll build strong relationships with stakeholders, provide regular project updates and help identify opportunities to improve the way we work.

This is a role with plenty of variety. Alongside office and home-based working, you'll occasionally visit sites to support project activities, undertake monitoring and supervision activities, and see first-hand the impact of the work being delivered.

Working as part of a supportive team, you'll help bring new ideas to life and ensure successful projects become part of our day-to-day operations, creating lasting benefits for the organisation and the communities we serve.

To find out more about the role, take a look at the job description.

Role location:
Hybrid Working (Remote but Connected)

This role is home-based, giving you the flexibility to work remotely for much of the time. However, being connected to your team, stakeholders and projects is an important part of the role. You'll be expected to travel regularly to our Mansfield office, project sites and other locations across the UK to support collaboration, stakeholder engagement and project delivery.

Schedule

Application closing date:26th October 2026

Sifting date:28th October 2026

Interviews: w/c 2nd November 2026

(If you are unavailable on these interview dates, please make us aware, and we will look at alternative dates)

Security

Successful candidates must pass basic security checks and will be subject to UK Immigration requirements.

,

Why join us?

Make a real difference with flexibility, long‑term security and support for life outside work.

At the Mining Remediation Authority, you’ll do meaningful work that improves people’s lives and protects the environment, while building a sustainable and balanced career.

Flexibility that fits your life - hybrid working and flexibility in how you manage your time
Financial security for your future - including a pension with up to 29% employer contribution
Time to recharge - 27.5 days’ annual leave plus bank holidays, with options to flex more days
Support through life’s big moments - generous family leave and flexibility when you need it most
Opportunities to grow - funded learning, development and professional subscriptions
Wellbeing support you can use every day - including a monthly wellbeing allowance, confidential support and practical health benefits

Find out more about our full range of benefits and what it’s like to work with us here Life page

About Us

At the Mining Remediation Authority, we make a real difference to people and places across Great Britain. From managing mining hazards to protecting the environment, our work keeps communities safe. We’re also playing an exciting role in the future of energy, helping to unlock mine water heat as a sustainable source to support the UK’s net zero ambitions. Our people are knowledgeable, collaborative and committed to doing the right thing for each other and for the communities we serve.

Why this matters

You’ll be joining an organisation that’s proud of the impact we make. We’re supportive, inclusive and genuinely care about delivering the right outcomes for communities across England, Scotland and Wales. Discover more about our work in our Business Plan

Inclusion matters to us

We’re committed to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve, and we welcome applications from everyone.

We offer a guaranteed interview scheme for disabled applicants and those from minority ethnic backgrounds who meet the minimum criteria.

If you need any adjustments as part of the recruitment process, please contact us at Recruitment@MiningRemediation.gov.uk or call 01623 637000 we’re here to support you.

jobs.title: Sustainment Project Manager
jobs.description:
SUSTAINMENT PROJECT MANAGER

Join Saab Australia (Saab) and help shape the future of defence, security and cyber technology.

For more than 35 years, Saab Australia has been a leading provider of defence, civil and security solutions, with an enduring purpose to keep people and society safe. We combine global expertise with local knowledge to deliver innovative, world-class solutions that support critical operations across Australia’s defence and security industries. From cyber security and communications to advanced defence systems and mixed reality technologies, our teams work on meaningful projects that make a real impact.

If you're looking for challenging work, cutting-edge technology, and the opportunity to contribute to something bigger, we'd love to hear from you.

What We Offer

At Saab Australia, we recognise that meaningful work is just one part of a rewarding career. We support our people with benefits that enhance wellbeing, flexibility and financial security, including:

Up to 6 weeks leave
14% employer superannuation contribution
Free Income Protection Insurance

For further information about a career at Saab, visit the page adjacent: https://www.saab.com/markets/australia/careers/saab-life

The role

The Project Manager leads in-service support and engineering change projects across our Engineering Sustainment Team, ensuring successful delivery of customer outcomes across Combat Management Systems on in-service Naval surface vessels.

Responsible for managing project scope, schedule, cost, quality and customer outcomes, you will drive the delivery of engineering change projects in line with contractual requirements and project directives whilst maintaining strong stakeholder engagement throughout the project lifecycle.

Further, the successful candidate will:

Lead the delivery of engineering change, capability enhancements, obsolescence remediation and defect resolution activities.
Manage project scope, schedule, budget, quality and governance activities to achieve agreed project outcomes.
Provide direction and support to the Engineering Sustainment Team to ensure successful project execution.
Develop and implement in-service support project strategies that deliver contractual obligations and maximise business outcomes.
Prepare, manage, and maintain project plans, budgets, forecasts, and schedules to achieve key milestones and objectives.
Identify, assess, and manage project risks, issues, and opportunities.
Lead project reviews and present progress updates to customers, steering committees, and senior stakeholders.
Manage contract variations, change requests, and evolving project scope.
Develop a strong understanding of the solution, its capabilities, and its operational application.
Build and maintain effective relationships with Defence customers, partners, and internal stakeholders.

Flexible work arrangements such as hybrid work from home / office, 9-day fortnight and part time (0.8 FTE minimum) will be considered for this role.

About You

Your skills and experience will include:

Tertiary qualifications in Science, Engineering, Business, related discipline or equivalent experience.
Demonstrated experience in project management and the delivery of sustainment projects, ideally in a Naval or Defence environment.
Strong understanding of project management principles, methodologies, and best practices.
Experience influencing teams and driving successful project outcomes.
Strong knowledge of engineering change management, in-service support and project delivery frameworks.
Proven ability to build collaboration, foster teamwork, and engage effectively with stakeholders.
Meeting the requirements of Australian Institute of Project Management CPPM accreditation or similar.

Applicants must be Australian citizens and hold or be able to obtain an Australian Defence Security Clearance to NV1 level. Information including past and present nationality and citizenship may be requested to check eligibility for access to materials controlled under various export control regimes, including ITAR.

What You Will Be Part Of

Explore a world of possibilities. Tackle challenges, drive innovation, and grow your career in an environment where curiosity and diverse perspectives are valued. Together, we achieve extraordinary outcomes, and your contribution matters.
Saab is a leading defence and security company with an enduring purpose to help nations keep their people and society safe. Supported by 28,000 employees worldwide, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world.
The company develops, manufactures, and sustains advanced systems across aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors, and underwater systems. Headquartered in Sweden, Saab has major operations all over the world and is part of the domestic defence capability of several nations. Learn more about Saab here.
We're committed to creating an environment where our people feel supported, empowered and inspired to do their best work.

Applications

To apply, please submit your CV and cover letter by clicking 'Apply'.
By submitting your application, you consent to Saab Australia's pre-employment screening process, which may include reference checks, Australian Federal Police checks, verification of working rights and qualifications, sanctions screening, and a pre-employment medical declaration.
Saab Australia is an Equal Opportunity Employer and welcomes applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, individuals from diverse cultural backgrounds, and ex-service personnel, veterans and their families.

Lead requirement workshops with Planning, Manufacturing, and Logistics teams to define business needs and drive adherence to standard SAP processes

at least 3 years of project management experience for enterprise level solution implementation project
Strong project management skills, including planning, risk/issue management, and budget or vendor oversight

Familiarity with standard ERP implementation methodology (Design-Build-Test-Dry Run-Go-Live)

jobs.description:
Req ID: 532079

At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, more than 80 000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

Could you be the full-time ISR (System and Infra) Project Manager in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, we’re looking for?

Your future role

Take on a new challenge and apply your expertise in Integrated Support and Logistics Analysis (ISR/LSA) in a cutting-edge field. You’ll work alongside collaborative and forward-thinking teammates.

You'll play a key role in ensuring the successful coordination and delivery of ISR activities for the Riyadh Line 2 Extension Project. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (engineering, operations, maintenance, and project management), engage with customers and consortium partners to build trusted relationships, and ensure compliance with contractual obligations, and much more.

You’ll specifically take care of overseeing the development and implementation of the ISR and LSA methodology, as well as the Transfer of Technology (ToT) and Operations and Maintenance (O&M) training processes, but also ensure that all deliverables are coherent, timely, and aligned with the project’s objectives.

We’ll look to you for:

Coordinating ISR activities across Alstom’s System and Infrastructure scope for the Riyadh Line 2 Extension Project
Ensuring all contributors and stakeholders fulfill ISR contractual obligations
Representing ISR System and Infra scope as the primary point of contact for related activities
Planning and coordinating Operations and Maintenance Training with project partners and the Employer
Developing and implementing ISR and LSA methodologies
Analyzing requirements and identifying risks linked with the ISR scope
Coordinating the production and review of ISR and training deliverables
Ensuring quality, cost, and time delivery targets are met
Collaborating with internal and external teams to ensure ISR requirements are integrated into material design
Drafting and maintaining management plans, processes, and procedures for ISR & Training activities
Monitoring progress and proposing recovery plans where needed

All About You

We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:

University degree in engineering or a related discipline
Experience or understanding of rail systems, particularly metro systems
Knowledge of railway maintenance, including Maintenance Management Systems (MMS)
Familiarity with operations and maintenance environments, documentation, and training coordination
A strong understanding of spare parts and tools definition
Fluency in English; Arabic is an advantage
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Collaboration and teamwork skills
Autonomy, accountability, and strong organizational skills
Responsiveness, proactivity, and adaptability

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

Important to note

As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

jobs.description:
Description

As an ACES Process Manager focused on DEA (Delivery Experience Accuracy) Process Excellence, you will own the end-to-end identification, analysis, and resolution of delivery promise failures across Mexico's fulfillment network. Beyond data — you will connect the numbers to real-world operations, finding root causes where packages fail, designing corrective actions, and implementing sustainable improvements that protect 130M+ annual customer promises.

You will apply Lean Six Sigma methodology (DMAIC) to systematically reduce DEA defects across all owners: Planning Systems, FC Execution, Linehaul, Sort Center, Air, AMZL, and Commercial Carriers. You will lead cross-functional improvement projects, manage stakeholders across 10+ teams, and drive accountability through structured governance mechanisms.

Key job responsibilities

Leading root cause analysis for DEA failures using structured problem-solving (5-Why, Fishbone, FMEA, FFaLS logic)
Owning DMAIC projects targeting the highest-impact defect buckets (Planning Systems, Last Mile, FC Execution, Linehaul)
Connecting data patterns to physical process failures — understanding how a "Rolled Freight" in the data maps to a real truck departure issue at the FC
Designing and implementing corrective actions (process changes, system configurations, SOP updates) with measurable impact on DEA
Building and maintaining Control Plans (SPC, OCAP) to sustain improvements and detect regressions early
Leading Kaizen events and War Rooms during Sev1/Sev2 DEA events, coordinating containment and permanent fixes
Managing the DEA governance cadence: daily callouts, weekly reviews, monthly goals reporting
Identifying waste (Muda) and variation in the promise-to-delivery chain and proposing structural improvements
Driving cross-functional alignment between Planning Systems, FC Ops, Transportation, and Last Mile teams to close systemic gaps
Benchmarking Mexico DEA processes against other geographies (BR, NA, EU) to identify best practices

A day in the life

You will start your day reviewing yesterday's DEA performance — identifying which nodes, carriers, or programs missed target. You will then dive deep into the top offenders, walking the Gemba (virtually or physically) to understand what went wrong operationally. You will present findings in the daily War Room, propose countermeasures, and track implementation.

Your Week Includes Cross-functional Meetings With

FC Operations for FC Execution issues
ATS Linehaul & Sort Center teams for middle-mile failures
AMZL (DSP, Flex, Hub) for last-mile delivery failures
Planning Systems & Tech (F2P, Promise, ATROPS) for systemic/configuration issues
Finance for impact quantification and business case development

About The Team

Amazon Customer Excellence System (ACES) is a team of highly qualified individuals responsible for the quality, productivity, safety, and speed of Amazon Operations. The DEA program within ACES owns the governance and continuous improvement of delivery promise accuracy — ensuring that when Amazon commits a delivery date to a customer, we deliver on that promise.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of program or project management experience
Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
Bachelor's degree
Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal

Preferred Qualifications

2+ years of driving process improvements experience
Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

You will keep Wardstone’s engineering moving. You’ll own the program schedule, run the status meetings, track the dependencies between teams, and make sure risks reach the founders while there’s still time to act. You’ll report to [the founders].

You’ll work across every engineering team, including mechanical, propulsion, aerodynamics, GNC, the seeker, and avionics, to get Hailstorm from design through ground test to flight. Own the schedule

Send regular, concise status updates to the founders and the team.

Manage risks and decisions

Escalate blockers early and help teams resolve conflicts over resources and priorities.

Coordinate tests and contracts

Experience running schedules for complex, multi-team engineering programs through test.

jobs.description:
About Hai Robotics

Hai Robotics is revolutionizing warehouse automation with intelligent robotics systems that deliver true customer value based on a unique combination of scalable standards with customer specific customization. Our mission is to empower fulfillment operations with cutting-edge technology and an obsessive customer focus. As we expand globally, we’re looking for a visionary leader to own the delivery of our implementations in the Americas region.

Job Summary

The CEO Amer has a grand vision to change the robotics industry in the Americas by focusing the Amer team around a mission based on customer obsession as opposed to robotic function. Our PMs are key to helping the CEO achieve his vision as they are the primary owners of delivering Hai Robotics’ projects to our customers and exemplifying delivery excellence and the embodiment of our customer obsession . The Senior PM is accountable for both the efficiency and quality of delivery, measured by site stabilization and Customer Success Index (CSI) performance respectively.
The PM is extremely proficient in the agile mindset, as well as various systems (AGV, ACR, AMR). This will be a technically capable Senior Project Manager for one of the most promising robotic companies in the world.

HAI Robotics has a fast-paced environment where we “Work Hard, Have Fun, Make History.” You will also spend time developing relationships with customers and vendors, collaborating with a talented team to find solutions to design challenges and investigating the root cause of customer issues.

You'll be part of a world-class team in a fast-paced environment that has the entrepreneurial feel of a start-up. This is an opportunity to help grow HAI’s market share in robotic automation systems in the US and on a global scale. You'll be surrounded by professionals, passionate about robotics, and believe that world-class service is critical to customer success. You'll be the go-to person within the US HAI robotics organization for project-related activities. You will bring operational scalability that sustains the platform's extreme growth.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Safety

Puts the safety of the team as the paramount objective.
Ensures that Hai’s safety practices are being followed in the field.

Delivery

The Senior PM is the primary owner of delivering Hai Robotic’s projects to our customers and exhibits our commitment to customer obsession in our implementations. They own delivery and is measured across 2 critical performance dimensions:
Efficiency – measured by how soon the Hai project team stabilizes the site, gets the customer to be self-sufficient and can exit.
Quality – measured by the CSI (Customer Success Index) which reflects how well we are meeting the customer’s defined (lagging) KPIs.

jobs.title: Experienced Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Are you ready to shape the future of insurance technology and driven by curiosity and eager to translate business and customer needs into clear actions?  

At If, we are in the middle of a major business and technology transformation. As we modernize our core insurance platforms through Guidewire InsuranceSuite, we are building capabilities that will influence how we serve our customers and develop our business for years to come.

We are now looking for a experienced business analyst to join our growing Business Development and Transformation team. Whether your experience comes from insurance, financial services or another complex business domain, this is an opportunity to contribute to a large-scale Nordic transformation and help build long-term business and platform capabilities across If.

About The Role

As a Business Analyst, you will work at the intersection of business and technology. You will help ensure that business needs are translated into sustainable solutions aligned with Guidewire Cloud principles and If's long-term direction.

You will work with Product Managers, Product Owners, Architects, development teams and business stakeholders to define, refine and prioritize epics and features that create business value.

By combining business understanding with platform knowledge and solution thinking, you will help us use the platform in a scalable and efficient way.

You will translate business needs into clear epics, features, user stories and acceptance criteria, and support teams throughout the development lifecycle.

An important part of the role is to challenge requirements that create unnecessary complexity and guide stakeholders toward solutions based on standard capabilities and SaaS best practices. You will help If adapt processes and ways of working to a modern cloud platform, rather than over-customizing the platform to preserve existing ways of working.

You will not join a ready-made setup. You will help define how If uses Guidewire Cloud across our Nordic business, influence future solutions and ways of working, and contribute to long-term capability building. The role also gives you the opportunity to deepen your Guidewire expertise while collaborating with experienced colleagues across business and technology.

This role combines business understanding, analysis and solution delivery in an agile environment. You will help shape business initiatives from early analysis and epic definition through feature refinement, delivery and validation, ensuring that solutions are scalable, sustainable and aligned with business goals.

Guidewire certifications and previous platform experience are considered a strong advantage. However, for candidates with the right business and analytical capabilities, we offer the opportunity and expect a commitment to developing Guidewire expertise, including relevant certifications, as part of the role.

What You Will Contribute To

Driving business analysis and requirement work from idea to implementation
Shaping business initiatives through epic, feature and user story refinement
Facilitating workshops and aligning stakeholders across business and technology
Supporting backlog prioritization and value-driven decision making
Defining acceptance criteria and contributing to testing and validation activities
Conducting impact analysis and helping identify dependencies across teams, processes and systems
Contributing to continuous improvement of business processes and platform capabilities

We offer

Benefits

In the same way that we place high demands on you as an employee, we also expect you to place high demands on us as an employer. Here are some of the benefits of working at If:

An including work environment where everyone is welcome
Career and development opportunities in the biggest insurance company in the Nordics
Social activities, as well as highly skilled professional environment
Possibility of hybrid workplace
Health promoting workplace with e.g., wellness allowance and various sports activities
Great insurance benefits

About The Team

You will join our growing Business Development and Transformation team, a Nordic competence community focused on shaping the future of If’s core business capabilities.

Together, we help translate business needs into sustainable solutions while supporting one of the largest business and technology transformations at If. We work across business domains, countries and delivery teams, combining business understanding, analysis and platform expertise to drive both current transformation initiatives and future business development.

Most of your day-to-day work will take place in agile and cross-functional teams, collaborating closely with Product Managers, Product Owners, Architects, Developers and business stakeholders.

At the same time, you will be part of a broader community where knowledge sharing, capability building and continuous learning are at the heart of how we work. You will have the opportunity to collaborate with experienced colleagues from different business domains, exchange perspectives and best practices, and continuously develop both your business analysis and platform expertise.

Our ambition is to build business professionals with strong platform understanding who can bridge business and technology, drive meaningful change and contribute to long-term value creation across If.

Who are You?

You are a structured and analytical professional who is comfortable navigating complex environments. You combine business understanding with strong system insight and can move between the bigger picture and the details when needed.

You have a strong attention to detail and the ability to translate complex business needs into clear, actionable requirements. You communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, helping create a shared understanding and alignment across business and delivery teams.

You take ownership of your area, collaborate well across organizational boundaries, and are confident in challenging assumptions constructively while guiding stakeholders toward pragmatic and sustainable solutions.

You Also Have

Experience working with Guidewire InsuranceSuite is highly valued.
Experience from other business-critical platforms, enterprise systems or complex transformation environments is also highly relevant.
Experience as a Business Analyst, Business Developer, Product Owner or in a similar role
Understanding of Cloud and SaaS-based delivery principles
Proven ability to create clear epics, features, user stories and acceptance criteria
Experience working in agile delivery models and supporting backlog refinement
Ability to translate between business needs and system solutions
Fluency in English; a Nordic language is considered an advantage
Guidewire certifications and experience from transformation programs are considered strong advantages

Additional Facts And The Recruitment Process

Application deadline:
Screening and interviewing will start immediately. However, application deadline is November 9th 2026
.

To apply for the position:
Please attach your CV and answer the questions in the questionnaire

Work location:
Any main office of If, Sweden or Finland

Travelling:
Occasional travel is required

Start:
As soon as possible / By agreement

For more information, please contact Sandra Jernberg, sandra.jernberg@if.se

Background checks will be conducted in accordance with the law in the country of employment.

We look forward to your application!

jobs.description:
Salary: Up to £70,000

Location: Sheffield HQ / Hybrid / Remote (Must be UK Based)

Twinkl is on an exciting journey to redefine how we serve our global teaching community through data. We're building a world-class data function to power the next generation of our data platform, with modern tools and practices at our core. Introducing new tools and concepts and elevating the business to a higher standard of Data Literacy.

As a Senior Data Analyst with a track record of using data to improve growth and funnel strategies, you will be a pivotal part of our dynamic Team of 20+ data professionals, helping to unlock the full potential of our extensive datasets.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will play a fundamental role in supporting an area's strategy through data-driven insights. You will collaborate closely with the B2B team to understand their objectives, analyse user behaviour, and identify opportunities for improvement. Your expertise in data analytics and insight delivery will enable you to uncover user frictions, hidden patterns, measure performance and make meaningful recommendations.

What will you be doing?

Build strong relationships with Product, Growth and cross-functional teams to understand business objectives and translate them into actionable analytical focus areas
Deliver deep insights and clear recommendations that shape the area strategy and drive innovation, growth, and customer value
Identify and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), developing strategies to improve them through data-driven experimentation and optimisation
Partner with Product Managers and Business Area Leads to conceptualise, prioritise, test, and launch new products and features based on data insights
Analyse A/B and multivariate tests to measure the impact of new features, content, and campaigns on user acquisition, engagement, and retention
Support digital analytics tracking by gathering requirements, raising implementation requests, and performing debugging and QA
Collaborate with Data Engineering teams to ensure data quality, define data requirements, and improve data collection processes
Independently troubleshoot tracking issues and escalate complex problems to technical specialists when needed
Stay current with developments in GCP, analytics tools, and trends in digital product and subscription businesses

What do we need from you?

Has extensive experience in a data or analytics role, ideally within an eCommerce or subscription-based business
Demonstrates a proven track record of analysing user behaviour by querying raw data from analytics platforms (e.g. GA4, Adobe Analytics) and delivering insights that drive measurable business outcomes in a fast-paced environment
Proficient in SQL and BigQuery, with experience using data visualisation tools (we use Looker Studio and Tableau); Python is a plus but not essential
Deep understanding of key eCommerce and subscription metrics such as Sessions, Bounce Rate, Conversion Rate, Retention, Churn, LTV, and ARPU
Strategic thinker with a strong grasp of experimentation principles, including A/B testing and experimental design methodologies
Excellent prioritisation and time management skills; comfortable working to deadlines and managing multiple tasks
Confident communicator who can present complex data and insights clearly to a range of stakeholders, including the Executive Team

What’s in it for you
?

A friendly, welcoming and supportive culture. We believe work should be fun and always put people before process
Flexible working with fully remote and hybrid working options - early bird or night owl? No problem - our flexible working policy helps you work the hours that suits you best
33 days annual leave per year, pro rata. You decide which public holidays to recognise. After 2 years of employment, your annual leave entitlement will accrue year on year up to 38 days annual leave
An additional day of annual leave, a Me Day, to take time for yourself
Charity day to volunteer and support a registered charity of your choice
Westfield Health (including Health Club discount and Westfield Rewards discount and cashback)
Learning and Development opportunities, with opportunities for internal mobility across various departments / areas of the business
4 x annual salary death in service life assurance
Enhanced pension after long service
Enhanced parental and adoption leave after long service
Quarterly awards designed to reward and recognise our wonderful Twinkl employees
Seasonal events for all UK employees so you can catch up with your new colleagues in person
Twinkl Subscription

At Twinkl, we encourage diversity, and our doors are open to everyone. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace for all. If you need any adjustments during the application process to showcase your abilities, please let us know. We're here to support you on your journey.

Ensure data quality and assist in metadata and requirements management

Skilled in modeling business processes and logical data flows to support system design and decision-making

Ability to query and analyze data to validate requirements and support insights

Health benefits. A competitive benefits package in addition to your salary that includes health insurance after the first 3 months pass in all three Baltic states, as well as Health days in case of your absence due to sickness without a doctor's note needed
Wellbeing. Access to tools and resources that help you feel good and be productive at work and in life
Professional growth. Internal and external training programs, LinkedIn learning, workshops, conferences, online training, etc
Special Offer for Luminor products & services. Enjoy special offers & pricing for products and services provided by Luminor
Gross salary. 3700 - 5500 EUR/month, which is to be determined depending on your level of experience and competencies

jobs.title: Business Analyst, Ikano Centres
jobs.description:
About Ikano Centres

Our portfolio of shopping centres are the hearts and hubs of our communities, creating a better everyday life for the 100 million visitors who visit us every year.

Together with our IKEA stores, we create meeting places for friends and families to have a safe and fun day out. We also develop land and invest in residential, office and other types of real estate to create vibrant destinations where people can live, work and play. With strong ambitions to grow our portfolio, we currently operate five meeting places in Malaysia and Thailand. These include IPC and MyTOWN in Kuala Lumpur, Toppen in Johor Bahru, the first phase of Klippa in Batu Kawan, and Megabangna in Bangkok. We are part of Ikano Retail, one of 12 IKEA franchisees and the only one owned by the family of Ingvar Kamprad, who founded IKEA in 1943. To learn more, visit our Ikano Centres website or LinkedIn page.

Job Description

We all know that malls are more than a place to shop.

At Ikano Centres, we also believe your work is more than a job.

About the job

As Business Analyst, you will be part of the Business Navigation team, taking a steering while collaborative role in supporting our Shopping Centres Management Team. You will provide clear business insights, financial analysis and leasing performance indicators to guide priorities and decision-making. Working closely with Commercial, Finance, Operations, Development and Centre Management teams, you will create alignment, clarify expectations and establish effective ways of working. Through a shared understanding of performance, opportunities and risks, you will help drive profitable leasing, operational efficiency and sustainable business growth across our Meeting Places.

Your assignment

Lead analysis of leasing income, rental performance, lease terms, vacancy, CAPEX contributions and related operating costs to provide a clear view of commercial performance.
Own the development of leasing income forecasts, budgets and financial projections for existing and future Meeting Places, ensuring assumptions are aligned, transparent and commercially sound.
Steer regular commercial and leasing performance reviews by identifying emerging trends, risks, opportunities and performance gaps, and translating them into clear priorities and actions.
Prepare decision-ready reports, financial analysis and presentations that provide management and commercial teams with clear insights, implications and recommended actions.
Act as a trusted business partner by challenging assumptions and providing fact-based insights and recommendations to improve leasing and wider business decisions.
Coordinate income planning, target setting, forecasting and performance follow-up across the portfolio, providing clarity on assumptions, accountabilities and required actions.
Collaborate closely with Commercial, Finance, Operations, Development and Centre Management teams to align priorities, strengthen information quality and establish consistent ways of working.
Drive continuous improvement of business analysis, reporting tools, governance routines and ways of working to enable faster, more consistent and better-informed decision-making.

Qualifications

Your profile

Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, Property or related disciplines.
5–8 years of relevant experience in business analysis, financial analysis, leasing operations or commercial reporting.
Strong understanding of budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis and business performance reporting.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into meaningful business insights and recommendations.
Proficient in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, business writing and business intelligence tools.
Proactive and collaborative, with good communication and stakeholder management skills.

Additional Information

Please apply by 12 November 2026.

The Enterprise Services Operations Analyst will gain broad exposure across Asset Servicing Operations and Custody Clearance & Settlement Operations while building an understanding of key operational processes, business workflows, and risk and control practices within a dynamic financial services environment. This role provides a strong foundation in operations, risk awareness, and business management while preparing analysts for future opportunities across the organization.

At DTCC, we help power the global financial markets by providing critical infrastructure that supports the safe and efficient processing of securities transactions. In this role, you will learn how your business area contributes to that broader mission while building practical skills through meaningful work, coaching, and structured development.

About The EDGE Program

EDGE is DTCC’s 18-month early-career development program for recent graduates. The program combines hands-on business experience, structured learning, mentorship, networking, and regular feedback to help analysts build technical, functional, and leadership capabilities.

What You Will Gain

A structured onboarding experience, including Welcome Week and program orientation.
Hands-on experience through meaningful work aligned to business priorities.
If non-rotational: Exposure across the team through projects, shadowing, and stretch assignments.
Monthly learning sessions, business education, professional development, and opportunities to hear from leaders and subject matter experts.
Regular feedback, including a 90-day feedback and assessment milestone, manager coaching, and program check-ins.
Mentorship, networking, and opportunities to build relationships across DTCC.

Areas of opportunity

Analysts in this role may gain exposure to areas such as:

Asset Servicing Operations, including corporate actions, income processing, and related client support activities.
Custody, Clearance & Settlement Operations, supporting the movement and processing of securities transactions across global markets.
Operational risk management, controls, and regulatory compliance practices that support the integrity of DTCC’s services.
Process improvement initiatives utilizing data analysis, automation, AI, and problem-solving techniques to enhance efficiency and reduce operational risk.
Cross-functional collaboration with leaders, subject matter experts, and stakeholders across DTCC to strengthen business knowledge, communication skills, and professional networks.

Complete structured training and learning activities to build foundational knowledge of Enterprise Services Operations, business processes, and industry practices.
Support day-to-day operational processes and assignments with accuracy, accountability, and a focus on risk and control standards.
Analyze processes, risks, and operational data to identify improvement opportunities and evaluate potential solutions using data, automation, AI, and problem-solving techniques.
Contribute to continuous improvement and cross-functional initiatives by partnering with colleagues, subject matter experts, and stakeholders across DTCC.

Embraces change, learns quickly, and adapts to new challenges

jobs.title: Experienced Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Are you ready to shape the future of insurance technology and driven by curiosity and eager to translate business and customer needs into clear actions?  

At If, we are in the middle of a major business and technology transformation. As we modernize our core insurance platforms through Guidewire InsuranceSuite, we are building capabilities that will influence how we serve our customers and develop our business for years to come.

We are now looking for a experienced business analyst to join our growing Business Development and Transformation team. Whether your experience comes from insurance, financial services or another complex business domain, this is an opportunity to contribute to a large-scale Nordic transformation and help build long-term business and platform capabilities across If.

About The Role

As a Business Analyst, you will work at the intersection of business and technology. You will help ensure that business needs are translated into sustainable solutions aligned with Guidewire Cloud principles and If's long-term direction.

You will work with Product Managers, Product Owners, Architects, development teams and business stakeholders to define, refine and prioritize epics and features that create business value.

By combining business understanding with platform knowledge and solution thinking, you will help us use the platform in a scalable and efficient way.

You will translate business needs into clear epics, features, user stories and acceptance criteria, and support teams throughout the development lifecycle.

An important part of the role is to challenge requirements that create unnecessary complexity and guide stakeholders toward solutions based on standard capabilities and SaaS best practices. You will help If adapt processes and ways of working to a modern cloud platform, rather than over-customizing the platform to preserve existing ways of working.

You will not join a ready-made setup. You will help define how If uses Guidewire Cloud across our Nordic business, influence future solutions and ways of working, and contribute to long-term capability building. The role also gives you the opportunity to deepen your Guidewire expertise while collaborating with experienced colleagues across business and technology.

This role combines business understanding, analysis and solution delivery in an agile environment. You will help shape business initiatives from early analysis and epic definition through feature refinement, delivery and validation, ensuring that solutions are scalable, sustainable and aligned with business goals.

Guidewire certifications and previous platform experience are considered a strong advantage. However, for candidates with the right business and analytical capabilities, we offer the opportunity and expect a commitment to developing Guidewire expertise, including relevant certifications, as part of the role.

What You Will Contribute To

Driving business analysis and requirement work from idea to implementation
Shaping business initiatives through epic, feature and user story refinement
Facilitating workshops and aligning stakeholders across business and technology
Supporting backlog prioritization and value-driven decision making
Defining acceptance criteria and contributing to testing and validation activities
Conducting impact analysis and helping identify dependencies across teams, processes and systems
Contributing to continuous improvement of business processes and platform capabilities

We offer

Benefits

In the same way that we place high demands on you as an employee, we also expect you to place high demands on us as an employer. Here are some of the benefits of working at If:

An including work environment where everyone is welcome
Career and development opportunities in the biggest insurance company in the Nordics
Social activities, as well as highly skilled professional environment
Possibility of hybrid workplace
Health promoting workplace with e.g., wellness allowance and various sports activities
Great insurance benefits

About The Team

You will join our growing Business Development and Transformation team, a Nordic competence community focused on shaping the future of If’s core business capabilities.

Together, we help translate business needs into sustainable solutions while supporting one of the largest business and technology transformations at If. We work across business domains, countries and delivery teams, combining business understanding, analysis and platform expertise to drive both current transformation initiatives and future business development.

Most of your day-to-day work will take place in agile and cross-functional teams, collaborating closely with Product Managers, Product Owners, Architects, Developers and business stakeholders.

At the same time, you will be part of a broader community where knowledge sharing, capability building and continuous learning are at the heart of how we work. You will have the opportunity to collaborate with experienced colleagues from different business domains, exchange perspectives and best practices, and continuously develop both your business analysis and platform expertise.

Our ambition is to build business professionals with strong platform understanding who can bridge business and technology, drive meaningful change and contribute to long-term value creation across If.

Who are You?

You are a structured and analytical professional who is comfortable navigating complex environments. You combine business understanding with strong system insight and can move between the bigger picture and the details when needed.

You have a strong attention to detail and the ability to translate complex business needs into clear, actionable requirements. You communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, helping create a shared understanding and alignment across business and delivery teams.

You take ownership of your area, collaborate well across organizational boundaries, and are confident in challenging assumptions constructively while guiding stakeholders toward pragmatic and sustainable solutions.

You Also Have

Experience working with Guidewire InsuranceSuite is highly valued.
Experience from other business-critical platforms, enterprise systems or complex transformation environments is also highly relevant.
Experience as a Business Analyst, Business Developer, Product Owner or in a similar role
Understanding of Cloud and SaaS-based delivery principles
Proven ability to create clear epics, features, user stories and acceptance criteria
Experience working in agile delivery models and supporting backlog refinement
Ability to translate between business needs and system solutions
Fluency in English; a Nordic language is considered an advantage
Guidewire certifications and experience from transformation programs are considered strong advantages

jobs.description:

ForTecMedical is an industry leader dedicated to improving patient health through innovative surgical technologies. Our mission is to enhance healthcare outcomes by delivering cutting-edge solutions on demand. Committed to excellence, integrity, and fostering a positive organizational culture, ForTecMedical strives to make a meaningful impact in the healthcare industry. We believe that our success is driven by our talented team, and we are dedicated to providing a supportive environment where employees can grow professionally while contributing to our mission of advancing patient care.

About The Role

The Technical Business Analyst at ForTecMedical plays a crucial role in bridging the gap between business needs and technological solutions. This position involves translating approved business and process requirements into detailed system specifications, including epics, user stories, and technical documentation. The analyst will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams such as product management, engineering, quality assurance, and customer support to ensure that system developments align with organizational goals and user needs. The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical skills, a thorough understanding of healthcare technology environments, and the ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and effectively.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Healthcare Administration, or a related field. A master’s degree is preferred.
Proven experience as a Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, or similar role within the healthcare or medical device industry.
Strong understanding of healthcare processes, regulatory requirements, and medical technologies.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data and translate it into actionable insights.
Proficiency in business analysis tools such as JIRA, Confluence, Microsoft Visio, and other relevant software.
Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to effectively liaise between technical teams and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments is highly desirable.

Responsibilities

Gather, analyze, and document business requirements from stakeholders, ensuring clarity and completeness.
Translate business needs into detailed system requirements, including epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
Collaborate with product managers, developers, and quality assurance teams to ensure technical specifications align with business objectives.

Maintain comprehensive documentation of requirements, workflows, and system configurations.
Act as a liaison between business units and technical teams to promote understanding and collaboration.
Stay updated on industry trends, regulatory changes, and emerging technologies relevant to healthcare and medical devices.

Extras That Matter: Free Teladoc account for virtual healthcare, employee assistance programs, employee referral bonuses, milestone awards, holiday bonuses, and performance-based recognition and rewards.

jobs.description:
What You Will Be Doing

The Project Manager's (PM) role is to plan and manage construction activities from conception to completion of the project in a timely and cost-effective manner. The PM responsibilities include, but are not limited to; project planning, budget management, schedule implementation, compliance with quality standards, contract administration and safety program management. 

GENERAL INFORMATION:
- Project Manager
- Exempt position
- Worksite location at construction jobsite trailer, or main offices, depending on company needs
- Reports to executive team members (VP of Construction, VP of Operations, CEO, etc.)
- Works closely with Project Superintendent, jobsite staff, main office staff, vendors, subcontractors, design professionals and clients.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES / TASKS:
- Ensure that construction activities move according to predetermined schedule, mitigating and reporting all potential delays by monitoring the progress of the construction activities on a regular basis and holding weekly status meetings with all the team members, subcontractors and clients and their consultants.
- Coordinate the efforts of all parties involved in the project, which include clients, architects, consultants, subcontractors and laborers.
- Maintain strict adherence to the budgetary guidelines, quality and safety standards.
- Daily inspection of construction site to monitor compliance with building and safety codes, and other applicable regulations.
- Study job specifications to determine appropriate construction methods.
- Identify the elements of project design and construction likely to produce constructability issues and plan coordination problems prior to beginning construction of the project. 
- Interpret and explain plans and contract terms to administrative staff, subcontractors, and clients
- Select, contract, and oversee workers who complete specific scopes of the project, such as painting or plumbing
- Prepare subcontracts and negotiate revisions, changes and additions to contractual agreements 
- Manage the budget, track project expenses and minimize exposure and risk in the project
- Collect, review and approve progress payments submitted by all subcontractors and vendors
- Ensure project documentation and reports are complete
- Handling complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others
- Serve as a key link with the clients and review the deliverable prepared by the team before passing onto client.

What You Need for this Position

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION:
- Graduate from an accredited four-year college or university with major coursework in construction science, engineering, architecture, or other related field and/or equivalent experience
- Minimum 5 years of experience in multi-family, wood framing, structural concrete, construction projects
- 3rd party general contractor experience is a plus

  SKILLS AND SPECIALIZED KNOWLEDGE :
- Excellent communication skills.
- Good understanding of mechanical, electrical and plumbing building systems.
- Advance knowledge of construction management processes, means and methods
- Thorough knowledge of legal issues and safety standards is essential.
- Ability to plan and organize a team effort.
- Good client management and goodwill building ability
- Capacity to motivate, lead and boost morale of the teams
- Competent in conflict and crisis management
- Effective time management and logical decision-making ability
- Capacity to handle pressure
- Willingness to travel extensively across the construction sites
- Physical and mental fitness is a given
- Strong focus on quality
- Recent working knowledge and competence of Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Excel, Word, and MS Project
- Knowledge and experience in Prolog or similar Project Management Software is a plus
- Maintain company confidentiality
- Bilingual in Spanish is a plus

We are willing to offer excellent compensation projects including:
- Competitive base salary (DOE) 
- Strong bonus structure 
- Benefits 
- Gas and Cell Allowance
- PTO & Sick Leave

jobs.description:
Closing date: Sunday, 1 November 2026

Contract type: Fixed Term Contract – Duration: 12 months

Interview dates: 1st stage (From 06/11) online/Remote; 2nd stage: face to face ; 3rd stage (Face to Face)

The Wellcome Trust is a global charitable foundation. We improve health for everyone by funding science, leading policy and advocacy campaigns, and building partnerships. 

We committed to spend £16bn in the ten years to 2032, funding new discoveries in life, health, and wellbeing, and taking on three global health challenges: mental health, infectious disease and climate and health.

These challenges need the bold science we support, but they won’t be solved by science alone.

The Investments Operations team is responsible for ensuring the smooth running of the investment process day-to-day and for the provision and management of timely, accurate and consistent data to portfolio managers, analysts and key stakeholders alike. To achieve these goals, the team works closely with service providers, counterparties, systems vendors and key internal parties and carries out a number of critical tasks on a regular and ad hoc basis. Additionally, the team is involved in several continuous improvement initiatives aimed at making our operating model more efficient and cost effective, to deliver value to the Trust and to therefore support the overall mission.

We are looking for an Investment Data and Operations Analyst to join our team for a 12months fixed term contract

Where in Wellcome will I be working?

You will play an important role in maintaining the data and operational processes that underpin Wellcome’s investment activities. By supporting the team’s day-to-day requirements, you will help ensure investment operations run effectively and support the delivery of the team’s wider objectives.

What will I be doing?

You'll oversee a broad range of investment operations, reporting and governance activities, working with internal colleagues and external partners to ensure Wellcome's portfolio is accurately managed, monitored and reported.

Overseeing day-to-day investment operations and reconciliations, ensuring processes are completed accurately and efficiently.
Managing operational activities across Wellcome's investment portfolio, working closely with external providers and internal stakeholders.
Monitoring and reconciling investment cash flows, valuations and portfolio activity to maintain accurate records and effective funding of investment activity.
Building and maintaining relationships with custodians, brokers and fund administrators to resolve issues and enhance operational effectiveness.
Coordinating regulatory, compliance and governance activities to ensure Wellcome meets its reporting obligations.
Producing and enhancing investment reports, dashboards and data insights that support decision-making and continuous improvement across the investment team.

Is this job for me?

This could be a great opportunity if you have experience in investment operations within an investment management or financial services environment, and enjoy working with investment data, reporting and operational processes across a range of asset classes. You'll thrive in this role if you're highly organised, analytical and collaborative, with the ability to build relationships, manage competing priorities and contribute effectively within a small, high-performing team.

To apply for this role please submit an updated CV and answer 2 application questions to demonstrate that you meet the minimum requirements for the role.

Minimum Criteria:

Demonstrable experience of working in an investment operations, asset management or wider financial services environment, with responsibility for operational processes, reconciliations and transaction management.
Experience supporting investment portfolios across public and private markets, including areas such as cash management, valuations, fund operations, trade processing or custody activities.
Experience producing, managing or analysing investment data and reporting, including the use of systems and tools to support portfolio oversight and decision-making.
Experience working with external service providers, custodians, fund administrators or other third-party partners to deliver operational, reporting or governance requirements.

Applications Questions:

Using examples please provide evidence to demonstrate that you meet the minimum criteria for this role as outlined in the job description? (Up to 500 words)
Using short summaries please provide specific details of up to two different initiatives or projects you have been directly involved in that are relevant to this role. For each initiative or project please use up to 250 words to describe your role (e.g. team leader, team member), the purpose of the activity (i.e. its aims), and the major contributions you personally made.

You can view the full job description on our website

You can read more about the benefits we offer our employees on our website

Our Hybrid Way of Working

We understand that our colleagues have commitments and personal interests outside of work and we strive to build a flexible working environment, in which people can perform at their best.

At Wellcome we have a hybrid way of working which is 3 days in our Euston Road offices (Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday) with the remaining 2 days working either remotely or in the office.

Diversity and Inclusion is at the heart of everything we do

Diversity and Inclusion is a priority at Wellcome
.
We are committed to cultivating a fair and inclusive environment, where everyone can be themselves and thrive. We are happy to discuss flexible working options for all roles. We work to ensure that our recruitment processes are as inclusive as possible to everyone. This includes making adjustments for people who have a disability or long-term condition. Please visit our website for more information on adjustments and accessibility, or contact us at jobs@wellcome.org.

In this role, you will coordinate the planning, implementation, and delivery of device logistics projects supporting clinical trials in the life sciences industry. You will oversee project activities from initial setup through closeout, ensuring that mobile devices, inventory, and international shipping operations are delivered on time and within scope. Working closely with subject matter experts, clinical teams, sponsors, and other stakeholders, you will help align project expectations and maintain smooth service delivery. You will also monitor budgets, manage deployment plans, identify potential risks, and develop contingency measures to address challenges. This opportunity is ideal for a detail-oriented project management professional who enjoys cross-functional collaboration and wants to contribute to clinical research operations in a remote working environment aligned with the US East Coast time zone.

Manage the implementation, delivery, and closeout of device logistics projects supporting electronic clinical outcome assessment (eCOA) studies.
Coordinate with subject matter experts to ensure inventory management, mobile device management, and global shipping activities are completed on schedule.
Oversee project budgets, track allocated hours, and support the change order process when project requirements evolve.
Collaborate with cross-functional clinical teams to define project scope, clarify responsibilities, and establish delivery expectations with key stakeholders.
Develop and maintain project-specific deployment plans, monitoring service delivery throughout the project lifecycle.
Communicate professionally and effectively with internal teams, sponsors, and other project stakeholders.
Identify project risks, establish appropriate contingency plans, and ensure compliance with applicable quality processes.

Experience in the life sciences or pharmaceutical industry.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to organize and monitor multiple project activities.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
Ability to build and maintain effective working relationships with colleagues, managers, clients, and cross-functional stakeholders.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
Ability to work remotely while coordinating effectively with teams operating in the US East Coast time zone.

Are you an experienced Project Manager looking for a role where you can lead interesting projects that make a real difference?

Would you enjoy working on projects that explore low-carbon mine water heat, environmental improvements and new services that could help shape the future of our work?

If so, we'd love to hear from you.

You'll already have experience delivering projects from planning through to completion and be comfortable managing multiple priorities, stakeholders and deadlines. You'll know how to keep projects moving forward, manage risks and overcome challenges when they arise. The role requires someone who can work independently, take ownership and confidently lead projects from start to finish.

We're looking for someone who enjoys finding practical solutions, building positive relationships and working with a wide range of people. You'll be able to communicate clearly, analyse information, monitor progress and provide updates that help others make informed decisions.

You don't need experience in our sector, but you will have experience managing projects from planning through to delivery and a good understanding of project management principles and best practice. Experience of introducing improvements, new processes, products or services would be particularly valuable.

You'll also be able to travel when required to our Mansfield office and project sites across the UK, including North East England and South East Scotland.

,

This is a temporary opportunity covering a colleague's secondment, giving you the chance to join an established team and make an immediate impact on a varied portfolio of projects.

As a Project Manager in our Innovation, By-Products and Service Delivery team, you'll help turn new ideas into practical projects that deliver real environmental and business benefits. You'll work on a range of projects, including low-carbon mine water heat, by-products and other innovative opportunities.

You'll be responsible for planning and managing projects from start to finish, working with colleagues, partners and suppliers to make sure projects are delivered safely, effectively and to agreed timescales. You'll build strong relationships with stakeholders, provide regular project updates and help identify opportunities to improve the way we work.

This is a role with plenty of variety. Alongside office and home-based working, you'll occasionally visit sites to support project activities, undertake monitoring and supervision activities, and see first-hand the impact of the work being delivered.

Working as part of a supportive team, you'll help bring new ideas to life and ensure successful projects become part of our day-to-day operations, creating lasting benefits for the organisation and the communities we serve.

To find out more about the role, take a look at the job description.

Hybrid Working (Remote but Connected)

This role is home-based, giving you the flexibility to work remotely for much of the time. However, being connected to your team, stakeholders and projects is an important part of the role. You'll be expected to travel regularly to our Mansfield office, project sites and other locations across the UK to support collaboration, stakeholder engagement and project delivery.

Security

Join Saab Australia (Saab) and help shape the future of defence, security and cyber technology.

For more than 35 years, Saab Australia has been a leading provider of defence, civil and security solutions, with an enduring purpose to keep people and society safe. We combine global expertise with local knowledge to deliver innovative, world-class solutions that support critical operations across Australia’s defence and security industries. If you're looking for challenging work, cutting-edge technology, and the opportunity to contribute to something bigger, we'd love to hear from you.

Up to 6 weeks leave

The role

The Project Manager leads in-service support and engineering change projects across our Engineering Sustainment Team, ensuring successful delivery of customer outcomes across Combat Management Systems on in-service Naval surface vessels.

Responsible for managing project scope, schedule, cost, quality and customer outcomes, you will drive the delivery of engineering change projects in line with contractual requirements and project directives whilst maintaining strong stakeholder engagement throughout the project lifecycle.

Further, the successful candidate will:

Lead the delivery of engineering change, capability enhancements, obsolescence remediation and defect resolution activities.
Manage project scope, schedule, budget, quality and governance activities to achieve agreed project outcomes.
Provide direction and support to the Engineering Sustainment Team to ensure successful project execution.
Develop and implement in-service support project strategies that deliver contractual obligations and maximise business outcomes.
Prepare, manage, and maintain project plans, budgets, forecasts, and schedules to achieve key milestones and objectives.
Identify, assess, and manage project risks, issues, and opportunities.

Your skills and experience will include:

Tertiary qualifications in Science, Engineering, Business, related discipline or equivalent experience.

Take on a new challenge and apply your expertise in Integrated Support and Logistics Analysis (ISR/LSA) in a cutting-edge field. You’ll work alongside collaborative and forward-thinking teammates.

You'll play a key role in ensuring the successful coordination and delivery of ISR activities for the Riyadh Line 2 Extension Project. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (engineering, operations, maintenance, and project management), engage with customers and consortium partners to build trusted relationships, and ensure compliance with contractual obligations, and much more.

You’ll specifically take care of overseeing the development and implementation of the ISR and LSA methodology, as well as the Transfer of Technology (ToT) and Operations and Maintenance (O&M) training processes, but also ensure that all deliverables are coherent, timely, and aligned with the project’s objectives.

Coordinating ISR activities across Alstom’s System and Infrastructure scope for the Riyadh Line 2 Extension Project

Representing ISR System and Infra scope as the primary point of contact for related activities
Planning and coordinating Operations and Maintenance Training with project partners and the Employer
Developing and implementing ISR and LSA methodologies
Analyzing requirements and identifying risks linked with the ISR scope
Coordinating the production and review of ISR and training deliverables
Ensuring quality, cost, and time delivery targets are met
Collaborating with internal and external teams to ensure ISR requirements are integrated into material design
Drafting and maintaining management plans, processes, and procedures for ISR & Training activities
Monitoring progress and proposing recovery plans where needed

All About You

We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:

University degree in engineering or a related discipline
Experience or understanding of rail systems, particularly metro systems

Fluency in English; Arabic is an advantage

Autonomy, accountability, and strong organizational skills
Responsiveness, proactivity, and adaptability
